name: Demonic Covenant
oracle_text:
Whenever one or more Demons you control attack a player, you draw a card and lose 1 life.
At the beginning of your end step, create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying, then mill two cards. If two cards that share all their card types were milled this way, sacrifice this enchantment.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying, then mill two cards. If two cards that share all their card types were milled this way, sacrifice this enchantment.

needs.what: a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids holds no 5/5 black Demon; the nearest are dragon_5_5_r_flying (wrong type and colour) and vampire_demon_4_3_wb_flying (wrong size, colours and types)

needs.what: a condition over the cards a `mill` bound with `as` that is true when two of them have exactly the same set of card types (e.g. both Land, both Creature, both Artifact Creature) -- the card-type twin of `two_share_a_color`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: condition_keys has `two_share_a_color` (colour, and sharing any rather than all) and the selector key `shares_a_type_with` (sharing at least one type, not all of them); neither compares the full card-type sets of two milled cards
